subject: Duplicate charge on May HalvardCare invoice

comments.author: Owen Castellane
comments.body: Hi team — pulled up our May 1 HalvardCare invoice for a second look and line item 14 appears twice, both billed at the same amount. That's a duplicated line item of $4,800 on the invoice dated 2026-05-01, and we'd like it corrected before we remit payment. Can someone confirm and issue a credit memo?

comments.author: Priya Natarajan
comments.body: Thanks for catching that, Owen. Pulling the invoice now to confirm on our side — will follow up with a corrected invoice or credit memo by end of week.

comments.author: Priya Natarajan
comments.body: Confirmed the duplicate line and issued a credit memo for the difference, sent to your billing contact this morning. Sorry for the trouble.

comments.author: Owen Castellane
comments.body: Got it, that matches what I expected. Closing this out on our end — thanks for the quick turnaround.
